name: cooperative-boardgame-bench
author: Coop Bench contributors
description: Remote cooperative board-game clients, player runtime, MCP bridge and auditable replay UI.

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/release-source.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/release-source.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:player:win: node scripts/release-source.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config build/player-electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:player:mac: node scripts/release-source.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --config build/player-electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.check: pnpm check:repo && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
